title: P10 百路媒体与分页负载长稳：两次完整测试结果
boundaries: 本次德国按当前P10口径评估PASS_SCOPED，前次上海INCONCLUSIVE；仅授各自实测范围，完整B11/整组、Formal及资格信用仍为0，release_eligible=false。
100路发布宣告三层视频；固定页仅16路自动低层，不能解读为100路高清同时解码。
服务端网卡RX丢弃仅记录、不作门限：德国累计+45及9个窗口保留；候选TCP重传/RTT未观察同步异常，但ICE关联只到端口与时间，因果仍INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE。
总wall仅作为效率记录：德国10009.281秒、上海9777.094秒；10500秒执行看门狗保留且两run均未触发。总耗时完整包含收敛、布局准备、保持及编排时间。
有效保持时长、每次动作恢复与媒体质量须达标；音频、采样覆盖、资源其他预算与清理等检查保持。前次存在3.016/3.297秒采样缺口且三门证据不完整，后续证据不追补旧run。
两台服务器、传输协议与链路不同，不构成单变量性能对照；本次仅按当前口径更新文档，未重跑产品、网络或长稳，未改动私有运行器。
2026-10-27阶段已收口(PARTIAL)；完整B11仍NOT_CLOSED，无物理Present/声学播放结论，无新增发布资格。

limitations: No GPU queue, decode hardware attribution, or performance threshold acceptance.
Busiest-engine percentage is not the Task Manager process GPU aggregation.

supported_findings: Both gaps occurred inside settled action holds, without reconnect or layout action boundary.
Native PCM and video counters continued; no multi-second native PCM gap was recorded.
Heartbeat advanced by three, leaving two intermediate status numbers absent from retained observer evidence in each gap.
Observed native probe collection segment remained in tens of milliseconds, not seconds.
Observer timestamps are assigned after status read and validation, before serial CPU/GPU/thread queries and full JSON/gzip output.
ICE collection runs on an independent thread; this run did not synchronously snapshot ICE in the observer loop.
unresolved: No per-stage duration timestamps distinguish status assembly/serialization/atomic commit from observer read/validation, PDH, thread enumeration, gzip write/flush or OS scheduling.
Heartbeat increments before QSaveFile commit; missing heartbeat numbers do not establish whether intermediate file commits succeeded.
No historical observer process CPU, disk or scheduling trace exists for these two intervals.

resampling_decision.next_minimum_gate: Add stage durations and successful/failed status commit counters; run a bounded short diagnostic with same probes and a decoder catalog warmed to comparable size, including grid4/grid9 holds.
resampling_decision.formal_gate_boundary: A short diagnostic establishes measurement reliability only. Closing the original 30m+2h continuous-coverage gates requires a new complete long run with its own evidence; no stitching or threshold relaxation.

decode_timeline.boundary: 该辅助诊断不更改完整P10INCONCLUSIVE；没有同窗口完整服务端资源判定，不能借用其他run补齐。

operation_summary: 真实登录入会/百路源+音频 → 全屏grid16下一页稳定后固定1800秒 → 20次连续翻页（末次10秒） → 混合16动作×9轮（每次收敛后50秒，共7200秒） → 恢复grid16下一页60秒 → 退出、资源释放与任务清理。

operation_sequence.scope: 两run同一已执行动作计划；已逐项核对各自observer.executed_plan与phase_observations。

steps.title: 准备并真实入会
steps.operation: 冻结产品/探针输入；启动默认GC的100路三层VP8视频与1路Opus参考音频；实际RelWithDebInfo客户端用保护账号登录并加入普通业务会议，确认百路发布。

steps.title: 固定页30分钟
steps.operation: 接收器全屏，grid16→下一页；等待提示条消失、媒体收敛且布局稳定至少3秒，冻结16路基线并保持1800秒。

steps.title: 20次连续翻页
steps.operation: 串行执行20次下一页；每次保留ACK与媒体收敛，前19次不另加保持，末次保持10秒，检查新页绑定/媒体及旧页静默。

steps.title: 混合长稳2小时
steps.operation: 按下列16动作顺序循环9轮，共144阶段；每个动作ACK且收敛后完整保持50秒，计划保持合计7200秒。

steps.title: 恢复基线60秒
steps.operation: grid16→下一页，恢复同源16路基线；再次等待提示条隐藏及布局稳定，冻结恢复窗口并保持60秒。

steps.title: 退出、清理与报告
steps.operation: 退出会议/客户端，核对native与Qt资源释放；停止任务拥有的发布器并清理命名空间、规则与临时凭据，执行清理复查并输出结果。

operation_sequence.mixed_cycle_labels: 4宫格 → 下一页 → 9宫格 → 下一页 → 16宫格 → 下一页 → 固定成员 → 取消固定 → 开白板 → 关白板 → 开始共享 → 停止共享 → 软重连 → 完整重连 → 最小化 → 恢复窗口
operation_sequence.continuous_observation: 全程记录动作ACK/收敛、选中/绑定/尺寸、RTP/组帧/解码/回调与帧龄、旧页静默、原生PCM连续性、双端资源和采样回执；最小化及布局过渡按原计划上下文解释。
